response.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_points_total, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId)

assumptions.assumption: "Upwards of 12" means grid > 12 (strictly greater, excluding 12). Grid 0 (pit lane start) is excluded.

Each driver is aggregated across all their qualifying race results (SUM of points, AVG of laps), then those per-driver values are averaged across drivers. laps is cast from TEXT to a number; NULLs are ignored by SUM/AVG.
